subject.title: Proposal: Publish a provider compatibility matrix with deprecation policy

question: Should OpenClaw commit to a public provider lifecycle matrix with stable/experimental/deprecated/broken statuses and deprecation windows across official, bundled, and community providers?
rationale: This would define support guarantees, metadata ownership, and public CLI/docs semantics, not merely add a missing docs table.

options.title: Approve Scoped Lifecycle Registry
options.body: Create a provider lifecycle registry with provider, model family, capability, status, deadline, replacement, and issue-link fields, then generate docs and doctor/models summaries from it.

options.title: Publish Docs-Only Policy First
options.body: Start with a human-readable provider support and deprecation policy before committing to a machine-readable registry or CLI output.

options.title: Defer Broad Guarantees
options.body: Keep provider status limited to catalog and live probe metadata for now and narrow this proposal to specific provider regressions.

recommendation.title: Approve Scoped Lifecycle Registry
recommendation.body: Create a provider lifecycle registry with provider, model family, capability, status, deadline, replacement, and issue-link fields, then generate docs and doctor/models summaries from it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history across provider/model docs, models CLI probe behavior, and prior review of this policy issue.
